dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒ gāi zǒu le.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 对，明天早上我还要上班。今天打扰你了！
dialogue.reading: Duì, míngtiān zǎoshang wǒ hái yào shàngbān. Jīntiān dǎrǎo nǐ le!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Nǎlǐ, nǐ lái wǒ hěn gāoxìng!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: 我也该走了。谢谢你，小南！
dialogue.reading: Wǒ yě gāi zǒu le. Xièxie nǐ, Xiǎonán!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 李老师，您慢走！王明，路上小心！
dialogue.reading: Lǐ lǎoshī, nín màn zǒu! Wáng Míng, lùshang xiǎoxīn!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: 我们离开以后，你早点儿休息吧。
dialogue.reading: Wǒmen líkāi yǐhòu, nǐ zǎo diǎnr xiūxi ba.
